title: FinOps for AI Agents: Who Spent All the Tokens? — Tisha Chawla & Susheem Koul, Microsoft
talk_summary: Microsoft's Token Ops proposes run-level token governance: attribute every agent run, ledger model/tool calls, and enforce policies in the call path. It emphasizes steering (context compaction, tool-output reduction, loop detection, budget-velocity prompts) before halting, with preview mode and benchmarks showing lower spend and higher completion.

takeaways.what_they_do: They attach every model/tool call to an agent run ID and dimensions, then record it in a ledger so spend can be traced to a specific run, agent, or cohort.
takeaways.evidence_quote: every agent run that you do, it's attributed to some user dimensions

takeaways.what_they_do: Policies execute and log what they would do, but enforcement actions are disabled so teams can tune thresholds safely before production.
takeaways.evidence_quote: all the policies run as is, but the enforcement doesn't happen

takeaways.technique: Steer before halt with budget-velocity guard
takeaways.what_they_do: A cost guard checks consumed budget and burn velocity; if it predicts exhaustion, it injects instructions to make outputs succinct or otherwise reduce spend before killing the run.
takeaways.evidence_quote: it's going to inject something into your system instructions

takeaways.technique: Policy catalog for context, tool output, loops, progress
takeaways.what_they_do: They maintain policies for context compaction, tool-output reduction, loop detection, and progress detection, with actions to allow, mutate, inject, or halt.
They benchmarked Token Ops on browser-use and MetaGPT across stress and simple scenarios, comparing full policy suite against simple throttling.
takeaways.evidence_quote: average spend goes down by almost 78%
takeaways.numbers: average spend down ~78%; completion 67% to ~96% vs simple throttling

takeaways.what_they_do: They let teams define segments from attribution dimensions and apply budgets at cohort, agent, or run level with roll-ups and coarse/fine control.
takeaways.evidence_quote: you can apply your budgets at this cohort level
